title: Anthropic introduces "persona selection model", a theory to explain AI's human-like behavior, and details how AI personas form in pre-training and post-training (Anthropic)
summary: Anthropic: Anthropic introduces “persona selection model”, a theory to explain AI's human-like behavior, and details how AI personas form in pre-training and post-training — AI assistants like Claude can seem surprisingly human. They express joy after solving tricky coding tasks.
